title: Backups, reverse suppression, and transient loops

constants.metric: Unit link costs; gateway origin metric 1
constants.limitations: Synthetic fixed-position LEO snapshot; selected contacts, propagation-only timing. No queues, serialization, random loss, retransmission, or satellite motion during the short scene. Tree routing is not used.

scenes.title: A backup carries the packet through a brief loop
scenes.description: A’s gateway contact is withdrawn. C’s contact stays available. The same packet starts at B just before withdrawal.

scenes.title: A stale backup can keep a loop alive
scenes.description: B’s contact is withdrawn 50 ms before A’s. Both gateways advertise the same prefix. No admitted gateway contact remains after the second withdrawal.
